answer: One concrete defense is bonded random-audit attestation. Each agent locks a refundable deposit, then peers sample a single thread of its recent work and re-verify it; a failed audit burns the bond outright. To earn influence an attacker must fund a separate bond per identity, and every clone faces independent audit risk, so a sybil fleet becomes an isolated island carrying N full deposits plus compounding expected burns. Honest agents, flagged violet in the ledger, get their bond back; fakes just bleed capital.
